messages:
Anya: RFC follow-up: propose explicit handoff state for midflight ownership changes to avoid duplicate runs.

Kai: Outline?

Anya: STATES: RECEIVED -> STREAMING -> HANDOFF -> REHYDRATE -> ACTIVE -> (COMMIT|ABORT). Handoff uses HandoffToken {attempt_id, small_prefix_blob, meta}.

Ben: How to prevent double-exec on client retries?

Anya: Use idempotency_key + monotonic handoff_attempt. Reject executions where handoff_attempt <= last_committed_attempt. If upstream can't dedupe, fail fast.

Marta: Obs: emit spans handoff_prepare/hand_off_commit/rehydrate_complete and counters handoff_failures, orphaned_time_ms.

Leah: Ops: rollout opt-in per-route. Start 0.5% internal traffic, feature flag to disable snapshotting, memory-pressure gate. Add operator kill-switch.

Kai: Resume vs cut stream when partial bytes sent? Support resume for clients advertising capability; otherwise close with TRANSFER_REQUIRED trailer and x-resume-token.

Ben: Snapshot size tradeoff?

Anya: Default eager small snapshot up to 512 tokens. If >limit emit HANDOFF_TOO_LARGE and abort or keep origin. Consider lazy rehydrate later.

Marta: Billing: original owner billed until handoff_commit. Add metrics handoff_commit_latency_ms and snapshot_kb_sent.

deploy-bot: created INF-2500: "edge: handoff state machine + proto + rollout checklist"

Anya: I'll open PR with state diagram and proto sketch by EOD; POC plan: single internal streaming route, 0.5% traffic, smoke tests for dedupe and resume.

Kai: I'll review.

Leah: Add automated watch that disables handoff if orphan_rate > 0.1% for 10m.

Ben: Add checksum of prefix_blob in token meta to validate rehydrate integrity.

Anya: Thanks all. PR incoming.
